Question: Does Zoom maintain an approved information security policy program that is reviewed at least annually?
Vendor response: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate issued 2026-02-17 by Schellman covering the Zoom UCaaS platform (Meetings and Chat in scope). ISO 27001 requires a management-approved ISMS and policy review. Policy documents themselves not available publicly.

Question: Does Zoom run a formal risk assessment process covering the services in scope?
Vendor response: ISO 27001 certification implies a risk assessment process (clause 6.1.2) but no direct public description of the process or its frequency was found. Detailed answers are in the gated CAIQ/SIG (E-19).

Question: Are employees background-checked and given security awareness training?
Vendor response: No public statement located. Answers exist in the gated CAIQ/SIG questionnaires.

Question: Can Banco Ejemplo enforce SSO (SAML) and MFA for its users? How is Zoom's own privileged access controlled?
Vendor response: Customer side: SAML 2.0 SSO is supported and account admins can require two-factor authentication for all users (Admin > Advanced > Security). Zoom side: privileged-access controls for Zoom staff are not described publicly (gated CAIQ).

Control area: Encryption in transit and at rest
Question: What encryption protects meeting content in transit and recordings/chat at rest? Who manages the keys?
Vendor response: Encryption whitepaper documents TLS for signaling and AES-256-GCM for meeting media in transit; cloud recordings and chat encrypted at rest. Key management is by Zoom by default (customer-managed keys are a separate paid offering per public docs — verify).

Question: Is end-to-end encryption available for meetings? Which features are disabled when it is on?
Vendor response: E2EE for meetings is available (design published on GitHub). When enabled it disables cloud recording live transcription and some join methods so it conflicts with the QA-recording use case; the bank must choose.

Question: Are security events logged and monitored? Can the customer get admin and sign-in audit logs?
Vendor response: Customer-side admin activity and sign-in logs exist in the Zoom admin portal (verify in support docs). Zoom's internal SOC monitoring is not described publicly.

Question: Is there regular vulnerability scanning and independent penetration testing? Is there a bug bounty?
Vendor response: Public VDP and bug bounty on HackerOne (public and private programs); security bulletins published with CVEs. No public statement on third-party penetration testing frequency.

Question: Does Zoom follow a secure SDLC with code review and security testing before release?
Vendor response: Security page states security is built in from design with proactive reviews after release; regular security bulletins show a working patch process. No detailed SDLC description public.

Question: Is there an incident response plan? What is the committed timeframe for notifying customers of a breach?
Vendor response: Global DPA commits to notifying the customer of a confirmed personal data breach "without undue delay" — no fixed hour count. US bank regulators' 2021 incident-notification rule expects bank service providers to notify "as soon as possible" when an incident materially disrupts service for 4+ hours.

Question: Are BC/DR plans tested? What uptime commitment and redundancy exist?
Vendor response: Availability SLA targets 99.9% monthly for eligible services excluding excused downtime; public status page at status.zoom.us. BC/DR test evidence is not public (would be in SOC 2 A1 criteria).

Question: Can the customer set retention for cloud recordings/chat? Is data deleted at contract end?
Vendor response: Admins can auto-delete cloud recordings after N days (minimum 1) at account/group/user level; deleted items sit in trash 30 days then are permanently removed. DPA covers deletion/return at end of service (verify clause).

Question: Where is customer data stored and processed? Can the customer restrict data regions?
Vendor response: Paid accounts can opt in/out of data center regions for meeting data in transit (default region fixed at provisioning). Storage location of recordings/chat depends on account settings. Puerto Rico accounts provision to the US region (verify).

Question: Does Zoom publish a subprocessor list and notify customers of changes?
Vendor response: Public list with change log (latest 2026-04-29): AWS Oracle Google Cloud Microsoft plus AI providers Anthropic OpenAI Perplexity ElevenLabs and others. Zoom commits to notify account owners of new subprocessors "to the extent required under contractual agreement" and to post updates.

Control area: AI features & use of customer content
Question: Does Zoom use customer audio/video/chat to train AI models? Can admins disable AI Companion features?
Vendor response: Zoom states it does not use customer audio video chat screen share attachments or similar content to train Zoom's or third-party AI models. AI Companion uses third-party models (OpenAI Anthropic Perplexity) via a federated approach. Admins can enable/disable AI Companion features at account/group/user level. Third-party retention terms are not stated on the public pages.

Question: Which independent reports exist (SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / CSA STAR)? Are they current?
Vendor response: ISO 27001:2022 certificate current (Feb 2026) and publicly verifiable. SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter exist but are gated (not obtained). CSA STAR entries: CAIQ from Sept 2022 and STAR Level 2 from Apr 2025 are both flagged deprecated/expired in the registry.
